Nina (Design): Quick thread about the batch vectors preview UX. Two sticky things: column resizing & persistent column order, and making the "Include context" toggle clear for exports and reranking. Figma: https://figma.com/file/preview-vectors :mag:

Omar (Frontend): Resizing is doable but we should persist sizes per-user or per-project? Per-project feels safer so teammates see same layout. Tech note: store sizes in user settings or workspace meta.

Ravi (Product): Prefer per-project default + per-user overrides. Default keeps shared view consistent for customer-support demos. Add a small "Restore default layout" action.

Fiona (A11y): Column headers need clear accessible names. If we allow drag-reorder, ensure aria-grabbed / aria-dropeffect semantics or use a keyboard reordering pattern (move left/right). Also ensure the visible column order is reflected in export column order.

Mark (Data): Export order mapping: we can honor the UI order if frontend sends fields in order (fields=[id,query,match,score,...]). Backend will accept ordered fields param. I'll add tests.

Omar (Frontend): Good. I'll implement drag + keyboard reorder with an explicit "Reorder columns" mode so arrow keys move the focused header. That avoids accidental moves.

Nina (Design): UX copy: For the "Include context" toggle (controls whether we include source doc text in export), options: label = "Include context" with helper: "Includes source text and metadata in export (may increase file size)". Thoughts?

Ravi (Product): Clear. Also add a tooltip icon: "Context = full text snippets and source ids". For privacy-conscious customers, default should be OFF.

Fiona (A11y): If default is off, ensure persistent warning when enabling: screen readers should announce "Context export enabled. Contains source text." Use aria-live polite after toggle.

Omar (Frontend): We'll wire aria-live and a confirmation banner that appears when enabling context, with an "Understood" button that focuses back to the toggle. Also add a keyboard shortcut: "R" to run rerank when table focused. Is that ok?

Ravi (Product): Shortcut is handy but should be opt-in/help documented. Maybe show a small shortcut hint in toolbar: "Press R to re-rank". Also require no modifier so it doesn't conflict with browser shortcuts — hmm that may be risky. Prefer Ctrl/Cmd+R? But that's usually reload. Suggest Shift+R as compromise.

Fiona (A11y): Avoid non-modified single-letter shortcuts; they interfere with typing. Shift+R is better but still tricky. Provide an accessibility setting to disable shortcuts. Announce shortcuts in a help dialog.

Mark (Data): For exports, CSV headers should include both friendly and raw names in a header comment line like `# friendly: ID,Query,Match,Score` then normal header for machines. Is that allowed? Some CSV parsers ignore comment lines; it's safe.

Nina (Design): I like the header-comment idea — makes files easier to inspect. Final toolbar order proposal: [Re-rank (primary)] [Include context (toggle)] [Columns (dropdown -> reorder, resize, restore default)] [Export (secondary)].

Omar (Frontend): I'll prototype the column controls dropdown and Shift+R shortcut with an opt-out switch in preferences. Will also persist per-project defaults and per-user overrides.

Ravi (Product): I'll draft the privacy copy for the context export confirmation and sign off.

Fiona (A11y): I'll provide keyboard reordering spec and example aria attributes for draggable headers.

ci-bot: Ran lint on branch vectors-ui-column-controls: 0 errors.

Nina (Design): Action items: Omar prototype, Fiona a11y spec, Mark backend fields-order support and comment header, Ravi copy for context warning, Nina will update Figma and microcopy. Follow up next Wed.
